template.name: Landledger: ask the approver in Slack
template.description: When a Landledger request waits on its approvers, each gets a Slack card with the request, the month’s numbers, the evidence hash and, on the budget owner’s step, an Approve button (Finance and CFO steps are decided in Landledger). The flow records every card; a press on a recorded card, by a full member of the workspace, is relayed to Landledger exactly as Slack signed it, and Landledger decides as the person who linked that Slack user. The card then says what happened, keeps its buttons with “Try again” if Landledger could not be reached, and is rebuilt when it went stale.

credentials.name: Landledger (requests)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with read and requests:write (read is enough here). Never decisions:relay or admin.

credentials.name: Landledger (webhooks)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with webhooks:write only: the Landledger Trigger subscribes itself on publish and keeps the signing secret Landledger returns (never shown). Or the whsec_ secret of a webhook an admin made, in Webhook Signing Secret.

credentials.name: Landledger (relay)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with decisions:relay and nothing else. Landledger verifies each press with the Slack relay channel an admin registered (signing secret, team, app).

credentials.name: Slack bot
credentials.description: A bot token (xoxb-…) with chat:write, users:read and users:read.email, and the app’s signing secret (for the button presses).

setup: Pick or add **Landledger (requests)** (`read`), **Landledger (webhooks)** (`webhooks:write` only, for **Step waits on approvers**) and **Landledger (relay)** (a key with `decisions:relay` only).

In Landledger, an admin registers the Slack app as a relay channel (signing secret, team id, app id), and each approver links their Slack account from their own profile (Link Slack). An unlinked presser is refused.
Pick the **Slack bot**: a bot token with `chat:write`, `users:read` and `users:read.email`, and the signing secret.
In **Check the press**, set `SLACK_TEAM_ID` and `SLACK_APP_ID` to the workspace and app: presses from anywhere else are not relayed.
Publish, then set **Button pressed**’s URL as the Slack app’s **Interactivity Request URL**.

Only the budget owner’s step of an infra change, AI budget, tool or seat, or other request has Approve; rejecting needs a reason and is done in Landledger. Finance and CFO steps are decided in Landledger. A card older than 30 minutes (or for a request that changed) is rebuilt when pressed, and the person presses again.

workflow.name: Landledger: ask the approver in Slack
workflow.description: Slack cards for a Landledger step, recorded; an Approve press on a recorded card by a workspace member is relayed raw for Landledger to verify and decide.

nodes.name: Get the request
nodes.notes: The request and the evidence Landledger shows, with the hash of exactly that: the card shows it and a press cites it.

nodes.name: Send the card
nodes.notes: A direct message to the approver (a member ID as the channel opens their DM).

nodes.name: Record the card
nodes.notes: Every card sent: a press is relayed only from a card recorded here, with the same request, step and evidence hash.

nodes.name: Button pressed
nodes.notes: Set this node's URL as the Slack app's Interactivity Request URL. Slack signs every press; the item keeps the raw body and the signature headers for Landledger to check again.

nodes.name: Check the press
nodes.notes: Set SLACK_TEAM_ID and SLACK_APP_ID: presses from any other workspace or app are not relayed.

nodes.name: Find the card
nodes.notes: A press on a card this flow never sent finds nothing here and stops: it is not relayed.

nodes.name: Who pressed
nodes.notes: Whether the presser is a guest, from another organization or deactivated (Landledger maps the Slack user to a person itself).

nodes.name: Check the card and who pressed
Relay the press
nodes.notes: The press exactly as Slack sent it, with the relay key. Landledger verifies Slack's signature, the team and the app, maps the Slack user to the person who linked it, and decides as them only on the budget owner's step.

nodes.name: Not relayed
nodes.notes: Check the card and who pressed says why: a button that does not match the card, a guest, someone from another organization, a deactivated user or a bot.

nodes.name: Update the card
nodes.notes: Decided: the buttons give way to what happened, with Open in Landledger. Landledger unreachable: the buttons stay, with Try again.
